english:
Scoring 2 Kills within 3 seconds of each with an <arc/>Arc Weapon spawns an Orb of Power.

2 second cooldown after an Orb spawns before additional kills are counted.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.75%|4.4% Super Energy.

source.text:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
